description.text: The second expansion of the BW series, released on 15 July 2011, a day before the mythical Victini's two films opened, with Victini on the wrapper. With Black Collection and White Collection it completes every Pokémon new in Pokémon Black and White, adding Kyurem, Landorus and the rest of Unova, and it brought the series' first restored Fossil Pokémon and the return of Pokémon Tools. Victini's Ability Victory Star lets its owner flip again when an attack's coin comes up tails. The cards are numbered to 66, with Super Rare Virizion, Terrakion, Cobalion, Victini and N and an Ultra Rare Meowth beyond that. In English it became Noble Victories in November 2011.
